implementation_notes: Resolve target_it_id by scanning info_type/info.off+dat for 'mini biography' (length 14).
Resolve target_lt_id by scanning link_type/link.off+dat for 'features' (length 8).
Driver path: for j in [pi_it_off[target_it_id], pi_it_off[target_it_id+1]): pi_row = pi_it_rowids[j]; check pi.note length==12 && memcmp=='Volker Boehm'; pid = pi_person_id[pi_row].
Per pid: check name.name_pcode_cf[pid-1] starts with 'D' via off/dat; check name.gender[pid-1] == code_m.
Per surviving pid: aka semi-join: scan an rows in [an_off[pid], an_off[pid+1]) for any aka_name.name containing 'a'; break on first hit.
Per qualified pid: enumerate ci rows from cast_info__person_id CSR; t_id = ci_movie_id[ci_row].
Per t_id: check production_year[t_id-1] in [1980,1984] and != INT32_MIN.
Per matched t_id: enumerate ml rows from movie_link__linked_movie_id CSR; if ml.link_type_id[ml_row] == target_lt_id, fold n.name and t.title into MIN aggregates.
Maintain min_name and min_title as best string_view seen; compare via lexicographic comparison of (length, bytes).
